verdict.rationale: ReadMe explicitly documents custom domain setup ('Hosting docs on your company domain... setup a custom domain from Configuration > Custom Domain') as a first-party feature aimed at professional branding, directly matching the story. There's no explicit mention of a /docs subpath configuration option, though custom domain hosting is the core capability requested. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of subpath (e.g., yoursite.com/docs) hosting configuration, and independent/hands-on confirmation beyond vendor docs.
